lines.quote: Developing the digital beamforming module for Aurinko's next-generation L-band weather radar receiver.
The module implements a 32-element uniform linear array with real-time adaptive weight computation on a Xilinx RFSoC platform.
I wrote the firmware in C, handled the DMA configuration and interrupt priorities, and validated the signal chain against a calibrated reference.

The system acquired 16 channels of biopotential data on a STM32H7 microcontroller, ran real-time IIR notch filtering and baseline wander removal, and streamed processed data over USB to a host PC for recording.

Python — wrote the offline calibration analysis pipeline at Aurinko in production Python (NumPy, SciPy, xarray): ~3,500 lines, tested with pytest, used by the RF engineering team for every calibration campaign.

Responsible for RF characterisation of the receiver front-end: conducted gain and phase measurements across the full array using a Keysight FieldFox N9918B handheld analyser and a custom near-field probe, establishing the per-element calibration vectors loaded into the beamformer firmware.
